preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer N, where 1 ≤ N ≤ 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000000 for x in stdin.split()[1:1+N])
preconditions.description: The second line contains N space-separated integers A0, A1, ..., AN−1, where each 1 ≤ Ai ≤ 10^6.
The third line is an integer Q, where 1 ≤ Q ≤ 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000000 for x in stdin.split()[2+N:])
preconditions.description: Each of the Q subsequent lines is an integer K, where 1 ≤ K ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q integers, one per query.
Each output integer is a non-negative count of subarrays.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == sum(1 for i in range(N) for j in range(i, N) if min(A[i:j+1]) == K) for i, K in enumerate(map(int, stdin.split()[2+N:])))
postconditions.description: For each query K, the output is the count of subarrays where the minimum element equals K.
